conditions: This is a fix-version claim: the described insecure interpolation defaults affect versions 1.5 through 1.9, and are not present starting with this version.
summary: Apache Commons Text 1.5 through 1.9 (Text4Shell) enables script, dns, and url StringLookup interpolators by default in StringSubstitutor.createInterpolator(). An app evaluating untrusted input like ${script:...} can trigger arbitrary code execution via the JVM script engine, or unwanted contact with remote servers via dns/url lookups (CVE-2022-42889, GHSA-599f-7c49-w659). Fixed in 1.10.0 by removing dns, url, and script from the defaults; enable via system property if needed.
